# Choose best match: name contains both 'Sabian' and 'B8X' (case-insensitive), and price closest to venmo_amount.
# If no such product, choose closest price regardless.

def score(p):
    name = (p.get('name') or '').lower()
    price = float(p.get('price') or 0)
    close = abs(price - venmo_amount) if venmo_amount is not None else 0
    has = (('sabian' in name) and ('b8x' in name))
